groups.saying_opens: كلمة حق أريد بها باطل إن رسول الله

notes: Two sayings with two isnads (rule 4a): Ali's words about the Kharijites, and Ibn Hunayn's sighting of the black man, which Bukayr continues from a man (رجل) and Ibn Hunayn (قال بكير وحدثني).
In the first, Ubayd Allah narrates he was there, and Ali speaks, so Ali is the last link.
The first two co-transmitters form one level (قالا).
